annotations.title: Live bat records near a roof

description: Searches the NBN Atlas (the UK's biodiversity records) live for bat records since 2000 within a radius of the customer's postcode, with the species and counts, and says what it means for roof work: where bats roost in roofs, the law on disturbing a roost, the signs to look for before stripping, the Bat Conservation Trust helpline, and felt instead of breathable membrane where bats roost. Example: {"postcode":"BA1 2LR","radius_km":2}.
name: bat_check
title: Live bat records near a roof
